elaine: ack. kicking off smoke tests now. will report back in ~5m. :white_check_mark:
jordan: FYI added a quick note in the release checklist about the reranker latency regression we saw on last night’s perf run. keep an eye on p99.
todd: requesting a pre-approved pin to v2.9.0 if any 5xx spike >0.5% or p99 > 650ms for >2min. tagging @oncall for visibility.
oncall-bot: @oncall paging rotation: elaine is oncall for eng-releases this window.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to 10% at 22:03Z. healthchecks passing (3/3) at 22:04Z. streaming logs to #eng-logs.
arnab: saw a small bump in reranker p95 at 22:05Z (+80ms). not critical yet but visible. pausing traffic shift if it trends up.
maria: collecting traces and sampling few requests - attaching quick curl check + log snippet:
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' 'https://staging.api.redwood.dev/health' | jq .
{"status":"ok","latency_ms":128}
```
arnab: thanks — logs show KV cache miss rate increased on one host (host-07). investigating.
deploy-bot: traffic shift paused at 22:07Z due to observed p95 delta threshold. canary remains at 10%. automatic fallback window armed.
elaine: agreed hold. switching monitoring to 15s polls, increasing sample size. assigning host-07 to infra-sre for immediate check.
jordan: note for rollback plan: if we need to revert, we will pin traffic to v2.9.0 and open a rollback PR with revert commit. please be ready with changelog note.
todd: +1. also please notify support to freeze user-visible experiments during rollback.
oncall-bot: alert created: ALRT-20260320-018 referring to p95 delta for reranker.
maria: quick postmortem draft prepared in case we need rollback — will paste into thread if we take that path.
deploy-bot: manual action required to continue. options: (1) continue rollout (manual confirm), (2) rollback to v2.9.0 (pin), (3) investigate and resume later. Please react with :white_check_mark: to continue, :arrow_left: to rollback, or :hourglass: to hold and investigate.
elaine: reacting with :hourglass: — hold and investigate.
jordan: adding :white_small_square: to coordinate infra runbook steps.
arnab: infra found degraded kernel parameter on host-07, restarting service to clear cache. ETA 3m.
maria: logs from host-07 after restart show p95 back to baseline.
deploy-bot: host-07 restart acknowledged. canary health at 22:15Z: all checks green for last 3 minutes. recommending resume to 50% with 2m observation.
todd: I vote resume -> :white_check_mark:. if trend persists, we roll back.
elaine: resuming to 50% at 22:17Z. will monitor.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 50% at 22:18Z. health: ok. next checkpoint at 22:20Z for full shift.
arnab: p95 stable in last 2m. good to proceed.
maria: running a targeted suite for reranker scenarios, all passing.
deploy-bot: full staging rollout complete at 22:22Z. final tag confirmed=release-2026-03-20 v2.9.1. summary: started=22:02Z, canary paused at 22:07Z, resumed 22:17Z, complete=22:22Z. no rollback performed.
jordan: leaving a short release note in the repo and updating the changelog. good job team. :tada:
elaine: will annotate console with pin window + metrics to watch in case we need to revert during next hour.
oncall-bot: deploy notice closed. monitoring alert ALRT-20260320-018 resolved at 22:21Z.
